entities.name: Domingo Pérez Cáceres
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Domingo Pérez Cáceres was a Spanish ecclesiastic, eighth Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of San Cristóbal de La Laguna. Was one of the most prominent bishops in the history of the Canary Islands, being well known for their aid to poor people in Canary Islands, who gave money, and for his many positions in the Catholic Church.
